name: Catalog Studio

guide.title: CSV catalog walkthrough and practice files

description: Turn a CSV product list and photos into a searchable catalog.
features: Quoted comma, semicolon and tab import with revisable header mapping
Physical CSV row evidence for missing, duplicate and invalid fields
SKU, filename and local fingerprint photo matching
Search, category filters, exclusion and atomic bulk changes
Twenty original fictional sample products with local SVG illustrations
Portable JSON projects including resized local photos
Actual standalone HTML search and image-aware print output
Optional private metadata workspaces, revisions and viewer/editor invitations
businessHypothesis: A small shop or maker may return to update real product sheets and photo sets. Optional private team workspace capacity and revision history provide a possible paid connection while the complete local import, repair and export workflow remains account-free. No customer, audience or revenue result has been measured.
